notes: A usage limit that only shows up as error text fails over and continues the thread by itself: aliax-core 95fb2ef classifies Claude and Codex limit messages (5h, weekly, credits, per-model, transient); the drivers tag error events with limit.window and log unclassified limit text to logs/limit-text-misses.log; AccountsService.failover charges the pinned account's window, picks the next account with room (the limited model counts as live during the pick), pins it and signs the CLIs in, sharing one switch between threads that hit the limit together; SessionRegistry waits for the thread to settle and sends one continue-run naming the switch, or leaves the Continue button when no account has room. scripts/e2e-limit-continue.ts covers an orchestrator and child limited at once, a weekly limit with no room, and a transient error. docs/PLAN.md's Aliax section now points at the plan outcome
